conviction_note: No Q3 2026 consensus could be sourced and the period is not pre-released. Nordic peers that reported this week (Inwido Q3 on 10-21, Beijer Ref Q3 on 10-22) and Systemair's May-July quarter give a mild positive read for Lindab's Nordic 41%. Against that: steel input costs kept rising through Q3, and management already warned that gross-margin pressure would persist into Q3. The stock is also up about 6% in 5 sessions while OMXS30 fell about 2.5%, which lifts the bar. That leaves p_up at 52 on an 8% scale: (2*0.52-1)*8 = +0.32. The findings sum (+0.6) is a little larger because each proxy is sized alone and the relative run-up is not a finding of mine; it sits in p_up instead.

already_public.what: Q2 2026 report: adj EBIT 218m (281), margin 6.6% (8.6), and gross-margin pressure flagged into Q3 and possibly Q4 (quartr summary of the call). Qualitative outlook only: European ventilation market to grow cautiously only in 2027, Profile Systems stabilising in 2026. No numeric guidance.

No profit warning (vinstvarning) or pre-release of Q3 in the Nasdaq Nordic feed. The only releases since Q2 are the Connaught (Ireland) acquisition on 07-14, the Aernova (Italy) acquisition on 09-18 and the nomination committee on 10-09.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 sales and adj EBIT are entirely new; the comparison base is Q3 2025 adj EBIT 315m, margin 9.7%. Expect a lower adj margin year on year on input costs, with a mild Nordic volume tailwind. Direction against the unsourced consensus is unknown, slight lean to in-line or a small beat because Nordea trimmed its target into the print.

Lindab gives no numeric guide. The market-outlook paragraph (2027 recovery timing, whether price increases now offset steel and transport) is the line most likely to move the stock. Direction unknown.
A cost or restructuring programme for DE/FR/NL is possible (Systemair is closing its Dutch plant), but nothing has been announced. Unknown.
Q2 operating cash flow was 275m (331); leverage including leases is about 2.7x against a 3.0x ceiling (Affärsvärlden, July). Unknown.

findings.finding: Direct Nordic building-product and HVAC peers reported strong Q3s this week. Inwido (10-21): organic order intake +7%, 'Sweden is improving', margins up in all business areas despite Middle-East-driven input, energy and transport costs. Beijer Ref (10-22): record quarter. Systemair's May-July quarter: organic +6% with all regions positive, stable gross margin and adj margin 9.9% (9.3). Lindab's Nordic region is 41% of sales and Profile Systems is now Scandinavian.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Lindab's report-day moves: Q3 2025 +13.9% on an adj EBIT beat (315 vs 303), Q4 2025 -6.4%, Q1 2026 -0.7%, Q2 2026 -15.3% on margin compression (closes from the Yahoo chart).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Lindab rose 1.6% on Inwido's day and about 2% on 10-22 while OMXS30 fell 1.9%, and is up 6% in 5 sessions. If fully priced, the stock would have closed the Q2 gap (it is still below the 07-16 pre-report level of about 141). Western Europe (45% of sales: DE/FR/NL) is not covered by these Nordic peers and was Lindab's own problem in Q2.
findings.independence: Systemair Q1 2026/27, a separate document: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd8b4baad659d594ff89b29c6b19e5581&lang=en&src=listed ; Beijer Ref Q3: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd4dafdaada30687a5276f758b60c13af&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: European steel prices kept rising through Q3 2026: Kallanish HRC at EUR 720-730/t delivered on 22 Sep, about EUR 20/t above August, with new EU import quotas. Steel is roughly 30% of Lindab's sales value, and management said in July it could not yet fully offset input costs and that gross-margin pressure may persist into Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (input-cost margin squeeze) -15.3%. But in Q3 2021, rising steel with early price increases lifted the margin to 16.2% and the quarter beat, so the sign depends on whether the price increases have landed.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the company itself warned of Q3 margin pressure, which puts this inside guidance. What is not known is whether the 'ambition to fully offset higher costs in coming months' has been delivered; that is the only unpriced part, and its sign is open.
findings.independence: Borsvarlden on Q3 2021 shows the opposite transmission (price increases ahead of steel): https://borsvarlden.com/artiklar/lindab-rapporterar-hogre-vinst-an-vantat-i-q3-uppdatering

findings.finding: Nordea cut its Lindab target to SEK 160 (166) and kept Buy on 2026-10-13, ten days before the print. Sell-side estimates are being trimmed into Q3, which lowers the bar after two consecutive misses.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 missed Yahoo EPS by 25% and the stock moved only -0.7%. Q2 missed by 20% and fell 15.3%.
findings.original_quote: Lindab Nordea sänker riktkursen för Lindab till 160 kronor (166), upprepar köp
findings.why_not_priced: It is public wire copy, so the cut itself is priced. What it implies, a lower consensus EBIT that the quarter has to clear, is an inference: it is not proven that Nordea cut its Q3 estimate rather than its multiple.

findings.finding: Systemair, a direct ventilation competitor, announced on 2026-09-29 the planned closure of its Waalwijk (Netherlands) plant, with a SEK 115m one-off charge. This confirms the Dutch weakness Lindab flagged in Q2 and makes a Lindab restructuring or cost programme in DE/FR/NL more plausible in this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2024: Lindab announced further cost savings and accelerated Profile Systems restructuring with an adj EBIT miss (304 vs 356); the stock fell 11.9% that day.
findings.why_not_priced: This is an inference about Lindab from a competitor's action, and a restructuring at Lindab could be read either way (a charge versus savings). It is sized near zero for that reason.
findings.independence: Lindab Q2 2026 report names Germany, France and the Netherlands as weak with intense price competition: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bf1a11752da61fb9d70abdc6349d5007b&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: Lindab is acquiring Italian smoke-control maker Aernova (EUR 7.1m sales, 'stark lönsamhet'), funded from existing credit facilities and closing in October. Small, but it adds to the fire-and-smoke growth story management is pushing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the announcement day (2026-09-18) the stock fell 3.3% on 3-4x volume while OMXS30 fell 0.8%, so the market did not reward it.
findings.original_quote: Företaget har en omsättning på 7,1 miljoner euro och stark lönsamhet. ... Förvärvet finansieras genom befintliga kreditfaciliteter. Transaktionen förväntas att slutföras i oktober i år.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and immaterial at about 0.6% of group sales. It matters only if the report reveals a margin or leverage detail.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Q3 2025 reported EPS of 7.29 (baseline) against adj EBIT of 315 suggests a one-off gain in the comparison base, so headline profit will fall sharply year on year
rejected_candidates.detail: The one-off's size and nature could not be confirmed in a primary document (the Börsvärlden figure 491 was reported as garbled), and a known base effect does not move a close-to-close window. Not filed.

baseline_tension: Mostly agrees with the baseline: priced_lean +0.57 (short covering, run-up) and the 5d run-up of +6% (about +8.5pp relative to OMXS30) already point the same mildly positive way as the peer read. That run-up raises the bar, which is why p_up sits only 2 points above 50.
language_note: The Nordea target cut to 160 (166) on 2026-10-13 surfaced only in Nyhetsbyrån Direkt's Swedish recommendations roundup on Placera; no English source carried it.

Affärsvärlden's Swedish analysis (via Placera, 2026-07-23) supplied the leverage-near-ceiling figure (2.7x including leases against a 3.0x cap) and an independent 2026E EBIT of 1,021m; the English wire summaries had neither.

The Swedish Börsvärlden archive gave the consensus-versus-actual history (Q3 2024 304 vs 356; Q3 2021 403 vs 355) used for reaction history; English aggregators had only undated Simply Wall St pieces.
Company filings were bilingual and identical; the Swedish versions added nothing over the English ones.
lessons_applied: Proxy and partly priced: peer read-through cut from +0.8 to +0.6 because it is a Nordic proxy for a company 45% exposed to Western Europe and the 5d relative run-up shows it is partly in the price.
Inside what the company already guided: the steel and input-cost finding moved from -0.3 toward 0 (-0.2) because management had already warned of Q3 gross-margin pressure.
Too small about the move: abs_move_pct raised from 7.5 to 8.0. The numbers are new, coverage is thin (3 analysts), and Lindab's observed report-day moves are 0.7/2.9/6.4/13.9/15.3.
Bar unsourced: p_up moved toward 50 (53 to 52); every finding is already capped small.
